blocks.text: Celebrity couple Marian Rivera and Dingdong Dantes have long wanted to do a project together that’s set abroad, but when opportunity knocked, the actress felt her hesitation creeping in. At the global media launch of their new movie, “Remember,” the showbiz royal couple said shooting in Quebec, Canada instantly became one of their most memorable project to date, not only because it is their first time filming together overseas; it was also the most chill. “Matagal na naming gustong gumawa ng project abroad, much more a film.
